name: Sustain self-propelled travel for 30 minutes
short_description: Continue purposeful self-propelled travel for 30 minutes by walking or cycling.
self_assessment: I can travel under my own power for 30 minutes without help or an unplanned rest.
description: Continue purposeful self-propelled travel for 30 minutes by walking or cycling. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
